# Alpha Premier Group of Companies

> Diversified Philippine business group headquartered at Unit 3104, Philippine Stock Exchange Centre, Tektite East Tower, Exchange Road, Ortigas Center, Pasig City. Real estate brokerage, luxury property management, construction, facility services, trading, outsourcing, talent management, and virtual offices. Phone: 0915 888 9482 / (02) 8 650 2540. Email: contact@alphapremiergroup.com.

## Enterprises

- [Alpha Premier Realty](https://realty.alphapremiergroup.com/): Commercial, industrial, and residential property brokerage
- [Luxe Prime Realty](https://luxe-prime.alphapremiergroup.com/): Co-managed subleasing and property administration
- [Alpha Premier Construction](https://construction.alphapremiergroup.com/): Fit-outs, civil works, MEP, materials supply
- [SwiftClear](https://swiftclear.alphapremiergroup.com/): Facility cleaning, disinfection, pest control, aircon maintenance
- [88 Prime](https://88prime.alphapremiergroup.com/): B2B corporate supplies, PVC/WPC panels, HVAC
- [Alta Venture](https://alta-venture.alphapremiergroup.com/): BPO, fractional CFO, talent & HR, IT, CX
- [Dynamic Tree](https://dynamic-tree.alphapremiergroup.com/): Talent management, modeling, event hosting
- [Virtual Office](https://virtual-office.alphapremiergroup.com/): SEC/DTI-compliant business addresses in Ortigas Center
